task.question: Does the nested five-line selector meet every pre-registered promotion gate versus same-target random five-line bundles?
task.novelty: Paired circular moving-block uncertainty, Holm-adjusted primary tests, temporal block consistency, and best-block deletion sensitivity determine promotion without retrospective tuning.

spec.research_question: Does the nested five-line selector meet every pre-registered promotion gate versus same-target random five-line bundles?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: E028 nested selector decisions use only the immediately preceding 200 target results; gate comparisons use identical target rounds.
spec.primary_metric: paired any_3plus and max_hits deltas with 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bounds above zero
spec.comparator: same-target mean of 100 random five-line portfolios
spec.multiplicity_correction: Holm step-down across the two registered primary tests for NESTED_DYNAMIC_5.
spec.novelty_signature: nested-five-line vs RANDOM_5_LINES; primary any3plus and max_hits; Holm2; paired circular block bootstrap; 50-round stability and best-block removal
